messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: APA Citation of the Lavaan
parts:
You can use the R function citation(). E.g.,

citation("lavaan")

Usually, it returns the preferred way to cite a package, set by the developers/authors.

The output can then be adapted for APA style.

Hope this helps.

-- Shu Fai
